script: Watch those ears flap and that tongue hang out the second the window drops, your dog isn't just enjoying the ride, they're getting hit with a flood of information. A moving car blasts them with dozens of new scents every second, way more than they'd ever get on a regular walk, and their brain treats it like a nonstop highlight reel. The wind against their face also stimulates nerve endings that genuinely feel good, almost like a full-body massage at speed. Then there's the mystery of it, every car ride could end at the park, the vet, or grandma's house, and that uncertainty keeps their brain fully locked in the whole time. It's sensory overload in the best possible way. Want to understand what's really going on inside that head of theirs? The link's below.
